      "step": 1,
      "text": "For {{ing_01|peas}} in the pod [1] Apician style take: [2] A clean earthen pot in which to cook the {{ing_01|peas}}; to the {{ing_01|peas}} add {{ing_02|finely cut Lucanian sausage}}, {{ing_03|little pork cakes}} [3], {{ing_04|pieces of meat}} [4] and {{ing_05|pork shoulder}} [5]."
    },

    },

      "step": 3,
      "text": "Unite this with the {{ing_01|peas}} in the earthen pot to which add {{ing_14|oil}} in sufficient quantity to be absorbed by the {{ing_01|peas}}; finish on a slow fire to give it live heat and serve."
